text.p: Perclose Inc said second quarter results were hit by the deferral of about $500,000 related to shipments of products to its French distributor during the quarter.
It said the deferral reflects a decision by the French national social security agency to disallow reimbursement to hospitals and clinics for the use of Perclose products.

Because this is a recent development, Perclose said it has not been able to assess the impact on future sales in France. But it did say that it believes the ruling will "have an adverse impact on future sales in France and on company-wide sales. It said French sales have recently accounted for about 40 percent of total revenues and have been growing.
Perclose makes suture-based closure devices for arterial access site management, which are used following diagnostic and therapeutic catheter procedures.
